deadlines.title: AAM 2027 call for proposals closes (23:59 PT)
deadlines.note: The strongest in-lane speaking call currently open anywhere. Track "Audience, Experiences & Value Creation" lists "Visitor Experience and Engagement Design" and "Exhibitions as Experience and Meaning-Making" — your lane, named twice, in their taxonomy. Case Study format: 60 min, max 2 presenters, deep dive into one project with measurable outcomes. THREE CATCHES: presenters must attend IN PERSON (Houston, 5-8 May 2027 — no streaming, and inability to attend is a listed disqualification); industry submissions must include a museum professional as co-presenter, so a former client has to say yes inside three weeks; and the page contradicts itself with a 26 Sep figure — treat 21 Sep as real. The decision this week is not submit-or-not, it is whether there is a museum co-presenter.

leads.title: Belasting & Douane Museum, Rotterdam — full re-fit going to European tender
leads.note: Marktconsultatie published 18 Aug for the herinrichting of the whole museum; a European tender follows. CPV 92520000-2. Douanedek wing already closed 6 Jul 2026, so the re-fit is real and moving. Collection + a genuinely good story (smuggling, customs, tax); Rotterdam ~1hr. Dutch-language process, and the eventual tender needs a partner — but the consultation is yours to enter alone and puts your name in the file before the brief is locked. Top pick this run (8/10).

leads.title: Spoorwegmuseum Utrecht — renewal masterplan completes 2026
leads.note: Cold approach, no posting. Masterplan being written NOW toward the 2027 centenary; they tried to build the concept team internally (3 roles, all closed 31 Jul); no structural subsidy, just reorganised to avoid bankruptcy. Their own words: knowledge "will be brought in from outside where needed". Lean one-person BV at €110–125/hr is the shape they can afford. Door: dir. Leontien Lems / Hoofd Publiek Cécile Brvar (newly recruited).

leads.title: Phone AFK about the categorie 3 pot before you draft anything
leads.note: Checked as promised: NO aanvraagstop posted today, cat 3 is open and still first-come. But AFK own numbers for H1 are the story — 356 applications Jan-30 Apr worth €6,256,593 against a €2,196,500 budget, 2.8x oversubscribed, closed 7 May at 08:00 with the pot dry in four months. The H2 pot is €1,761,493, about 20% SMALLER, and opened 1 July — we are eight weeks in. There is no live counter, so the only way to know is to ask: 020 520 0520. That one call decides whether "All the Museums of Amsterdam" is a this-half-year application or a January one. Separately: the real long-lead item is the intentieverklaring from an Amsterdam venue — that letter, not the form, is what takes weeks.
